en.content: A battery of 3.0 V is connected to a resistor dissipating 0.5 W of power. If the terminal voltage of the battery is 2.5 V, the power dissipated within the internal resistance is :
en.explanation:
PR = 0.5 W

i2R = 0.5 W

iR = 2.5

i = 0.2 A & R = 12.5

Also, V = E – ir

2.5 = 3 – (0.2)r

r = 2.5

Power dissipated in internal resistance

= i2r = (0.2)2(2.5) = 0.1 W
